ctgui.editing.title: Editing %s Recipe
ctgui.editing.save_description: Saves the changes you made to the recipe. When exporting the original recipe will be removed and yours will be added.
ctgui.editing.save_description_editing_c: Replaces the recipe change you are editing.
ctgui.editing.save_new_description: Saves the new recipe you made. It will work when exporting to crafttweaker but is already visible in emi/jei.
ctgui.editing.save_new_description_editi: Saves the changed recipe you made as a new recipe without deleting the original.
ctgui.editing.delete_description: Deletes the recipe you are editing and closes this screen. Don't use this if you want to replace a recipe.
ctgui.editing.unsupported: Unsupported recipe implementation in otherwise supported recipe category
ctgui.editing.unsupported_viewer: Recipe can not be displayed with the currently installed Recipe-Viewers
ctgui.editing.options_warning: [CraftTweaker GUI] You are using options only intended for recipe editing. Disable them after you're done!
ctgui.editing.options.secondary_output_c: Secondary output chance (If the main output is empty this is capped between 0.01 and 0.99)
ctgui.editing.options.additional_require: Energy required additional to the base energy
ctgui.editing.options.per_tick_usage_che: If the chemical should be gradually used every tick or all at once (This also means you cannot change the amount by anything smaller than the processing time)
ctgui.editing.options.composting_chance: Chance that the composter will be filled one layer
ctgui.editing.options.alloy_forgery.fuel: Fuel consumed per tick (By default coal gives 1000 and lava bucket gives 24000)
ctgui.editing.vanilla_smelting_recipe: This recipe is actually a vanilla smelting recipe and the original smelting recipe has to be edited
ctgui.editing.vanilla_blasting_recipe: This recipe is actually a vanilla blasting recipe and the original blasting recipe has to be edited
ctgui.editing.milling_recipe: This recipe is actually a milling recipe and the original milling recipe has to be edited
ctgui.editing.multipage_info_recipe: Multi-Page info recipes are currently not supported
ctgui.editing.unavailable: Only available when editing an existing recipe
ctgui.editing.recipe_id_editing: The id of the Recipe. This will not be used when changing an existing recipe!
ctgui.editing.to_small_description: Decrease your GUI Scale to edit a recipe
ctgui.editing.no_server: CraftTweaker GUI is designed to be used in Singleplayer. You need to manually upload your generated script each time you export it and after reloading changes will work for other players but not appear in their changes list. Planning changes in singleplayer and uploading the finished script to the server later may work better.
ctgui.list.title: Changed Recipes
ctgui.list.export_server: You have to upload the exported script to the server manually!
ctgui.list.edit_mode_true: Click to disable the edit mode. You can still let this screen enabled to allow users to view all changed recipes.
ctgui.list.edit_mode_false: Click to enable the edit mode.
ctgui.list.list_button_true: Click to disable the shortcut button in the pause menu. You can still access this screen through the options in the mod list or by editing a recipe.
ctgui.list.list_button_false: Click to enable the shortcut button in the pause menu to this screen.
ctgui.list.only_ingame: Enter a world to open this menu
ctgui.list.rejoin_warning: You may need to rejoin the world (or /reload) for all changes to take effect
ctgui.help.title: Help
ctgui.help.choose: How to use CraftTweaker GUI is described in the description on Curseforge and Modrinth.
ctgui.export_notice: Changes exported to CraftTweaker. You have to rejoin your world or /reload for them to take effect.
ctgui.recipe_added: This recipe will be added when recipe changes are applied
ctgui.recipe_changed: This recipe will be replaced when recipe changes are applied
ctgui.recipe_removed: This recipe will be removed when recipe changes are applied
ctgui.changes_saved: Export them to CraftTweaker so they apply
ctgui.error_message: Check your log for more details
